supportingSources.label: Flippers.com Spring Break original and single-ball PROM listing
MAME Spring Break and single-ball ROM definitions

strategy.summary: On the earned-Multiball setting, complete 1-2-3 and shoot the indicated Release feature to add balls. Playfield activity raises Playfield X, and completing V-A-C-A-T-I-O-N lights Extra Ball.

quickInfo.name: Release
quickInfo.summary: Complete 1-2-3, then shoot the playfield feature whose Release lamp is lit to add balls.

quickInfo.name: Playfield X
quickInfo.summary: Playfield activity and top-lane-to-bumper feeds raise the scoring multiplier.

quickInfo.name: VACATION
quickInfo.summary: Complete the word to light Extra Ball at its lit collect lane.

steps.text: Press the right flipper to launch the ball.
To earn Multiball, hit the lit 1, 2, and 3 standups. Then shoot the playfield feature whose Release lamp is lit to add balls.
To raise Playfield X, keep the ball active on playfield switches; top-lane and pop-bumper activity supplies repeated switch hits.
To light Extra Ball, complete V-A-C-A-T-I-O-N at the three drop-target banks, then shoot the lane whose Extra Ball lamp is lit.

cautions.issue: A failed shooter-lane exit switch can prevent later automatic launches and stop the game.
cautions.response: Confirm that the first launched ball registers the exit switch before you depend on added balls.

cautions.issue: Playfield X depends on continued playfield switch activity.
cautions.response: Keep balls moving through the bumpers before you pursue slower drop-target awards.

checkBeforePlay: Test the shooter-lane exit switch before depending on automatic multiball launches.

quickInfo.name: Continuous Multiball
